credit.title: Credit Management
credit.description: Manage credit reward policies and user balances.

settings.title: Credit Management
settings.description: Manage credit reward policies and user balances.
settings.page_intro: Reward events, daily limits, activity levels, ads, and AI usage fees apply to My Page credits, attendance, shell rankings, and AI Smart Chat / App Builder. Review each section before saving.
settings.read_only_message: You do not have permission to update credit settings. This page is read-only.
settings.save_error: An error occurred while saving credit settings.

sections.rewards_description: Configure rewards for login, posting, comments, likes, and attendance checks.
sections.limits_description: Daily limits to prevent excessive credit farming.
sections.ads_description: Settings for switching attendance rewards to Google ad-based rewards later.
sections.levels_description: Start points for 10 levels based on cumulative ranking_points. Tier names come from UI i18n.
sections.ai_spend_description: Per-use personal credit rates for AI Smart Chat and AI App Builder. Disabled means free.

fields.daily_earn_limit: Daily total earn limit per user
fields.max_app_review_write_rewards_per_day: App review write rewards per day

hints.daily_earn_limit: Use 0 if you want to treat the limit as unlimited.
hints.ads: The My Page button rewards immediately for now. Enable this later when the ad viewing flow is connected.
hints.levels: Lv.1 is fixed at 0. Remaining values must be non-decreasing integers shared by rankings, EXP bar, and badges.
hints.ai_spend: All billing is off (free) by default. Token-precise billing adds per-1K prompt/completion rates on top of the per-message fee.

user_credits.title: User Credits
user_credits.description: View user balances and manually increase or decrease credits.
user_credits.search_placeholder: Search by name, email, or nickname

modal.title: Adjust Credits
modal.description: Increase or decrease credits for the selected user.
modal.invalid_amount: Enter an amount of 1 or more.

delete_modal.title: Delete Credit Data
delete_modal.description: Permanently delete the selected user's balance, transaction ledger, and attendance records.
delete_modal.warning: Deleted credit data cannot be recovered. The user account remains; only credit records are removed.
